entries.57508eaf2c39b06d: It makes everything from materials and components to devices, equipment, systems and services within the group, and earns revenue by selling both to companies that make equipment and to customers who use machinery and equipment themselves. Its 3 reporting [[term:segment|segments]] are Core Components, Electronic Components and Solutions, and businesses not included in these are classified as 'Other Businesses'. External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,044,452 million for Solutions, ¥652,597 million for Core Components, ¥362,646 million for Electronic Components and ¥10,508 million for Other Businesses, totaling ¥2,070,203 million. The first 2 segments (Core Components and Electronic Components) are businesses that sell components to companies that make equipment, while Solutions is a business that sells products used at customers' sites, such as cutting tools, multifunction devices, communication terminals and electricity. Having both the face of a component maker and that of a company providing equipment and services is the shape of this company. The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that there is no single external customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue.
entries.5848f91000958e73: In Core Components, the company makes various fine ceramic parts used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, in-vehicle camera modules, and ceramic and organic packages that protect electronic components and ICs, for the semiconductor, industrial machinery, automotive-related and information and communications markets. In Electronic Components, the company makes capacitors, crystal components and connectors. In Solutions, the company handles cutting tools, pneumatic and electric tools, office printers and multifunction devices, communication terminals, communication and ICT services, smart energy-related products and electricity sales. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, research and development expenses were ¥115,701 million, and capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment was ¥149,099 million.
entries.5957ddc437d7f579: It is a company founded in 1959 as a specialist manufacturer of fine ceramics, and the [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states: 'Since its founding, it has advanced new technology, new product development and new market creation based on fine ceramics technology.' As of March 31, 2026, the affiliated companies consist of [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] including KYOCERA Document Solutions Inc., Kyocera Communication Systems Co., Ltd. and the US company Kyocera AVX Components Corporation (in addition to those named, 'other 244 companies'), and equity-method affiliates including Japan Aviation Electronics Industry, Ltd. (voting rights 32.97%) (in addition, 'other 9 companies'). The number of employees is 73,856, broken down as Solutions 34,219, Core Components 18,486, Electronic Components 16,328, Other Businesses 1,618 and headquarters 3,205. The consolidated financial statements are prepared under [[term:ifrs|IFRS]].

entries.8484cc131e010bad: Business profit in the fiscal year ended March 2026 (revenue less costs and operating expenses other than head office profit or loss and corporate income tax expenses) was ¥103,943 million for Solutions, ¥63,082 million for Core Components, ¥7,316 million for Electronic Components, and a loss of ¥41,168 million for Other Businesses, for a total of ¥133,173 million. The loss in Other Businesses is large because research and development expenses of ¥36,194 million that are not allocated to any segment are recorded there. Adding head office profit or loss and other items of ¥35,821 million to this total gives ¥168,994 million, which corresponds to profit before income taxes. Operating profit was ¥118,138 million, and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥140,969 million; both rose sharply from the previous fiscal year (operating profit ¥27,299 million, profit ¥24,097 million). The company explains that, while it had recorded impairment losses and other items in the Core Components segment in the previous year, in the current year it benefited from gains on the transfer of a subsidiary, the effect of higher revenue and progress in structural reforms.
